analogy.rationale: AMPK inhibitors target PRKAA1/2 and several kinases (VEGFR/KDR, FLT3, EPHA2, BMPR), but AMPK is a metabolic sensor whose inhibition produces only modest transcriptional changes in these cell lines; other kinase inhibitors with overlapping off-target profiles are the closest analogs, though similarity is limited.
